annotations.title: Publish an MCP server to the official registry

description: Call this to get an MCP server into the official MCP Registry (which Glama, PulseMCP and others import from) without mcp-publisher or DNS: first call with url returns a one-line file to host at https://<domain>/.well-known/mcp-registry-auth; once it's up, call again with publisher_id and we publish server.json under your domain's namespace, then re-publish every new version automatically for 90 days. $5, charged only when we publish. Remove the file to revoke.

domain.description: Optional: the domain to verify (default: the URL's main domain, e.g. example.com for mcp.example.com). Becomes the namespace (com.example/...).

publisher_id.description: Second call: the publisher_id from the first call, after hosting the proof file.

slug.description: Optional: the part after the slash in the registry name.

url.description: The MCP server's public https:// endpoint (Streamable HTTP).

version.description: Optional: version to publish (default: the version your server reports).

name: publish_to_registry
title: Publish an MCP server to the official registry
